lines.text: Agentic A.I. Software that doesn't just answer. It plans, acts, and checks its own work.
An A.I. assistant answers your questions, and then you decide what to do. An A.I. agent takes a goal, works out the steps, and gets it done.
Agents work in a loop. They perceive the situation, plan the next step, act on it, and reflect on the result. Again and again, until the goal is met.
Tools turn answers into actions. An agent can search for information, write and run code, use other apps, and remember what worked.
But autonomy needs guardrails. Clear goals and limits. Permission before risky actions. And people who review the results.
Give it a goal. Get an outcome.
